description: A luxurious contemporary stairwell viewed from an elevated overhead angle, looking down into the double-height void from the upper landing level. The staircase features richly veined dark grey marble treads with a high-gloss polish, flanked by a glass-panel balustrade railing with slender brass or gold-toned frame members. The walls are finished in warm oyster or greige toned plaster panels with subtle applied moulding details and a wainscoting band visible along the lower portion. The floor at the base visible at the bottom of the frame is also deep grey veined marble. A dramatic floral installation sits at the base of the stairwell — a dense arrangement of vivid golden-yellow blooms suggesting silk or real orchid branches spreading outward from a dark vessel, creating a bold organic statement at the focal point of the void. The overall palette is cool and grey-marbled, warmed by the brass-toned metal accents and the vivid yellow floral at the base. Multiple elongated glowing column forms cascade vertically at varying heights from the ceiling down through the stairwell void, their surfaces translucent alabaster white glowing with warm amber light, suspended on fine brass wires. Camera positioned at elevated height — 7+ feet — looking steeply downward into the stairwell void, with a wide lens capturing the full spiral-like arrangement of the cascade and the stair geometry below. A lighting fixture matching the product reference image is installed naturally within this scene at the appropriate location for the product category. Render the fixture exactly per the reference image — preserve all proportions, materials, finishes, and design details.
